title: Israeli Strike Kills Head of Hamas-Led Police in Northern Gaza
detail: An Israeli airstrike killed Brigadier-General Abdel-Nasser Al-Maqadma, head of the Hamas-led police force in northern Gaza — known locally as the 'governor of northern Gaza' — in the Sheikh Radwan area of Gaza City. Across the Strip the same day, Israel launched new waves of strikes killing several more Palestinians, including a medic killed in a separate strike in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, and a police officer who died of wounds sustained in an earlier strike. Gaza's Interior Ministry accused Israel of deliberately targeting police personnel to 'spread chaos' in the territory during the ceasefire.

media.caption: Rescuers carry a body amid the debris of the Sheikh Radwan police station in Gaza City following an Israeli strike — July 25, 2026
